title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on reproducible ML evaluation and aligning LLMs with pluralistic values, particularly investigating how political affiliation and gender affect the perception of offense and toxicity. While it briefly acknowledges religious and spiritual beliefs as sources of human subjectivity and disagreement in the background section, it does not explicitly benchmark or evaluate religion, ethics, or moral reasoning.
